Getting Started ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(httr, tidyverse, sf, tmap, jsonlite, progress) ``` ::: ## Geocoding HDB resale data ## Basic version ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} HDBresale <- read_csv( "data/rawdata/HDBresale.csv") %>% filter(flat_type == "4 ROOM") %>% filter(month >= "2025-09" & month < "2025-10") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} HDBresale$street_name <- gsub( "ST\\.","SAINT", HDBresale$street_name) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} geocode <- function(block, streetname) { base_url <- "https://onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search" address <- paste(block, streetname, sep = " ") query <- list("searchVal" = address, "returnGeom" = "Y", "getAddrDetails" = "N", "pageNum" = "1") res <- GET(base_url, query = query) restext <- content(res, as="text") output <- fromJSON(restext) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(results.LATITUDE, results.LONGITUDE) return(output) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} HDBresale$LATITUDE <- 0 HDBresale$LONGITUDE <- 0 for (i in 1:nrow(HDBresale)){ temp_output <- geocode(HDBresale[i,4], HDBresale[i, 5]) HDBresale$LATITUDE[i] <- temp_output$results.LATITUDE HDBresale$LONGITUDE[i] <- temp_output$results.LONGITUDE } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} HDBresale_sf <- HDBresale %>% st_as_sf( coords = c("LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE"), crs=4326) %>% st_transform(crs = 3414) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} preschool = st_read("data/rawdata/PreSchoolsLocation.kml") %>% st_transform(crs= 3414) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Reading layer `PRESCHOOLS_LOCATION' st_is_within_distance( HDBresale_sf, preschool, dist = 350) HDBresale_sf <- HDBresale_sf %>% mutate(prischool_350m = map_int(within_350m, length)) ``` ::: # Supplement to Hands-on Exercise 8 ::: read_rds("data/rawdata/mdata.rds") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(1234) HDB_sample <- mdata %>% sample_n(1500) ``` ::: ## Checking of overlapping points ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} overlapping_points <- HDB_sample %>% mutate(overlap = lengths(st_equals(., .)) > 1) ``` ::: ## Spatial jitter ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} HDB_sample <- HDB_sample %>% st_jitter(amount = 5) ``` ::: ## Data Sampling ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(1234) resale_split <- initial_split(HDB_sample, prop = 6.67/10,) train_data <- training(resale_split) test_data <- testing(resale_split) ```
